name: bag_of_holding_costs_are_paid_in_full_and_the_tap_is_a_cost
notes: Printed: '{2}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card. / {4}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: ...'. With one mana the loot is refused. With two it is paid and the Bag taps. A tapped Bag cannot loot again even with the mana in the pool, and cannot be sacrificed for {4} either (the tap is part of its cost): both are refused and the Bag stays on the battlefield, tapped.
